check.prompt: What is a commit in Git?
options: A saved snapshot of your changes, with a message
A copy of the whole internet
A way to delete a branch
check.explanation: A commit records the state of your files at a point in time, with a message saying why.
check.hint: It is a snapshot you can return to.

options: So your changes stay separate until they are ready to merge
check.explanation: A branch isolates work in progress, so main stays stable and several people can work at once.

options: A small, focused change with a clear message
Every change from the whole week in one commit
check.explanation: Small, well-described commits are easy to review, understand and undo.
check.hint: Think about reading the history later.
